pathofexile episodes: E315 pathofexile and newzealand (the logo beneath the Laser Kiwi flag, the alliance of the game made in New Zealand with the national room, the beam's deflection and a colour change, h12.1 to 65.1; CAJOS, Tripwyr and ryan-a in both; this closes the B1b-12 lead), E316 pathofexile and hongkong (PPCG's logo move agreed with PoE, through LegionMammal978), E317 pathofexile and diablo (ThaFaub helping r/Diablo's late mark). Added at B1b-14: pathofexile joins E277 (the Danish move and LEGO over Path of Exile; JurijFedorov in r/lego and r/pathofexile). Not episodes: OnePiece c0120 (a PoE member asking OnePiece to be friends, h39.7) and frankocean's border (pathofexile c0214, c0215) are not told on the other side; falcons, loliconsunite, overwatch, starcraft and theitalyplace name PoE in passing. Leads in unread rooms: denmark 480, austria 499, bardmains 607, hungary 376, globaloffensive 642. Room end pathofexile (order 322): 20 themes, all placed, no new kind; 9 rule 0 lines and 8 bags. T3-127 hoping the creators notice the work gains a room (t20, asking GGG to use the art in its office and as a cloak). What the room adds: a game room that ran its logo through stickies, a Discord and moderators, defended its first ally New Zealand, ceded space by treaties and then argued whether the pixel banner was worth displaying.
